import sys, pandas as pd, numpy as np
sys.path.insert\(0,'src/scripts'\)
daily = pd.read_csv\('data/processed/preprocessed_daily.csv', index_col=0, parse_dates=True\)
from statsmodels.tsa.seasonal import STL
series = daily['daily_active_kwh'].dropna\(\)
print\('Series length:', len\(series\)\)
stl = STL\(series, period=365, robust=True\)
r = stl.fit\(\)
resid = pd.Series\(r.resid, index=series.index\)
print\('Residual stats:', resid.describe\(\)\)
print\('May 2025 residuals:'\)
print\(resid['2025-05'].round\(4\)\)
print\('MAD:', np.median\(np.abs\(resid - resid.median\(\)\)\)\)
" 2>&1)
